lastCompletedStory.title: Run one headless dispatch against a real child process with no TTY and an idle budget

nextStoryContext: headless-dispatch.ts exports runHeadlessDispatch(opts: RunHeadlessDispatchOptions): Promise<HeadlessDispatchOutcome>. Options: { argv, env, cwd?, inputMessage, log: HeadlessDispatchLogWriter (US-002's openHeadlessDispatchLog(...) return value), idleBudgetMs? }. It spawns via Bun.spawn({ cmd: argv, env, stdin:'pipe', stdout:'pipe', stderr:'ignore' }) -- NEVER `terminal` (that is the whole no-TTY contract, GOTCHA F). Writes inputMessage (newline-terminated) to the stdin FileSink then calls .end() -- this is a SINGLE-TURN dispatch: the child only starts emitting once it sees EOF on stdin (matches the fixture's `stdin.on('end', ...)` gating, which future stories reusing this fixture must respect). Consumes stdout line-by-line through classifyHeadlessStreamLine (US-002) and appends every raw line verbatim via log.appendLine (US-002), tracking the LAST 'result' event's totalCostUsd. Outcome is a discriminated union: { kind:'completed', exitCode, totalCostUsd } when the child's own stdout stream ends (EOF), or { kind:'idle-timeout', totalCostUsd } when DEFAULT_HEADLESS_IDLE_BUDGET_MS (45 min, Warren precedent, GOTCHA E) -- or the injected idleBudgetMs -- elapses since the last received chunk with no EOF; on idle-timeout the child is killed with SIGTERM and proc.exited is awaited before returning. Completion is NEVER a pane probe (GOTCHA E): no isPaneAlive call anywhere in this module, which is exactly what US-005 (the loop.ts:1433 pane-liveness branch, injected isPaneAlive that THROWS when called) will assert against once this dispatch function is wired into the route. Bun API gotcha worth knowing for any future consumer: `ReturnType<Subprocess['stdout']['getReader']>` resolves the WRONG (last, BYOB-shadowed) overload under this repo's dom-less tsconfig -- always derive the reader type by calling `.getReader()` with zero args inside a small wrapper function and taking `ReturnType<typeof thatWrapper>` instead (see getDefaultStdoutReader in headless-dispatch.ts). Fixture gotcha: a child process with no pending timer/handle exits naturally (exit 0) the instant its stdin 'end' handler returns, even with a `process.on('SIGTERM', ...)` listener registered -- test/fixtures/headless/fixture-child.ts's 'idle' mode needs an explicit `setInterval(() => {}, 1_000_000)` after its one emitted event to stay alive until the parent's SIGTERM actually arrives; any new fixture that must 'hang' needs the same pending-handle trick.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirms: `terminal` is the only option that attaches a PTY -- when provided the child sees isTTY===true and proc.stdin/stdout/stderr become null (use proc.terminal instead); simply omitting it is the entire no-TTY contract this story implements. Confirms `stdin:'pipe'` returns a FileSink with incremental write()/flush()/end(); `stdout` defaults to a ReadableStream<Uint8Array>; `exited` is `Promise<number>`; `kill(exitCode?: number | NodeJS.Signals)` accepts a signal name string directly (e.g. `proc.kill('SIGTERM')`), matching this module's IDLE_KILL_SIGNAL usage.
